# Tellus Explorer alpha

Import either the Fabric or NeoForge `.mrpack` into a **new** Prism Launcher
instance. Use Java 25 and create a fresh Earth world.

The pack includes Tellus and Distant Horizons fork builds, The Mighty
Architectury, Sodium, Iris, Bliss and Complementary Reimagined. Shaders start
disabled. **Tellus Expeditions is not included.**

The release workflow tests the pack tooling, downloads and verifies the exact
locked files, and audits both exports and SHA-256 checksums. Those are packaging
checks, **not an in-game or performance certification**. Check the README and
version-specific verification evidence before relying on a new combination.

Third-party files are fetched from their pinned official downloads during
installation; their licenses and credits remain applicable. This is a client
pack, not a validated dedicated-server distribution.
